mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM organ_info
WHERE ORGAN_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%')
WHERE DEPARTMENT LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%')
WHERE AREA_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%')
ORDER BY ORGAN_ID

SELECT * FROM area_info
WHERE DONG LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%') OR GUGUN LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%') OR SIDO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%') OR LI LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%')
ORDER BY AREA_CODE
LIMIT #{start}, #{length}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM area_info

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM area_info
WHERE AREA_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%') OR CONCAT(SIDO,' ',GUGUN,' ',DONG,' ',LI) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organ_info (ORGAN_ID, ORGAN_NAME, DEPARTMENT, AREA_CODE, SORT_BASE, AREA_MAIN, AREA_SUB ) VALUES ( (SELECT IFNULL( MAX(ORGAN_ID) + 1, 1 ) AS organ_id FROM organ_info AS ALIAS_FOR_SUBQUERY), #{organ_name}, #{department}, #{area_code}, #{sort_base}, #{area_main}, #{area_sub} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.ORGAN_ID, (SELECT ORGAN_NAME FROM organ_info WHERE ORGAN_ID = a.ORGAN_ID ) AS ORGAN_NAME, a.USER_TYPE, a.MENU_TYPE, a.USER_ID, a.USER_PWD, a.USER_NAME, a.EMAIL, AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(MOBILE), MD5(32956)) AS MOBILE, a.IS_PERMIT, AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(SMART_MOBILE), MD5(32956)) AS SMART_MOBILE , a.SMART_USE FROM user_info AS a
SELECT a.USER_ID, b.GROUP_ID, a.RTU_ID FROM user_right AS a LEFT JOIN rtu_group AS b ON a.RTU_ID = b.RTU_ID
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO user_right (USER_ID, RTU_ID, RTU_RIGHT) VALUES
( #{user_id}, #{item}, 7)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM user_info WHERE USER_ID = #{user_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_info( ORGAN_ID, USER_TYPE, MENU_TYPE, USER_ID, USER_PWD, USER_NAME, EMAIL, MOBILE, IS_PERMIT, SMART_MOBILE, SMART_USE, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{organ_id}, #{user_type}, #{menu_type}, #{user_id}, #{user_pwd}, #{user_name}, #{email}, HEX(AES_ENCRYPT(#{mobile}, MD5(32956))), #{is_permit}, HEX(AES_ENCRYPT(#{smart_mobile}, MD5(32956))), #{smart_use}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT a.* , b.LINE_NAME, c.MODEL_NAME, AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(a.CONNECTION_INFO), MD5(32956)) as DECRYT_CON_INFO FROM rtu_info AS a LEFT JOIN line_info AS b ON a.LINE_NO = b.LINE_NO LEFT JOIN model_info AS c ON a.MODEL_NO = c.MODEL_NO
ORDER BY a.SORT_FLAG
ORDER BY a.AREA_CODE
ORDER BY a.RTU_NAME
SELECT LINE_NO, LINE_NAME FROM line_info ORDER BY LINE_NO
SELECT MODEL_NO, MODEL_NAME FROM model_info ORDER BY MODEL_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE rtu_info SET SIGNAL_ID = #{signal_id}, AREA_CODE = #{area_code}, RTU_NAME = #{rtu_name}, ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id}, LINE_NO = #{line_no}, MODEL_NO = #{model_no}, RTU_TYPE = #{rtu_type}, CONNECTION_INFO = HEX(AES_ENCRYPT(#{connection_info}, MD5(32956))), BROADCAST_SETTING = #{broadcast_setting}, CALL_LAST = #{call_last}, SORT_FLAG = #{sort_flag}, PORT = #{port}, BAUDRATE = #{baudrate}, VHF_USE = #{vhf_use}, VHF_SYSTEM_ID = #{vhf_system_id}, VHF_RTU_ID = #{vhf_rtu_id}, VHF_TRANS_ID = #{vhf_trans_id}, REG_DATE = #{reg_date} WHERE RTU_ID = #{rtu_id}
